question: Which of the following gases is used to inflate the car tyres?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nitrogen**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Compressed air**, which is **typically **used to **fill automobile tyres**, is **a mixture of various gases **and **78% nitrogen, 21% oxygen, and 1% water vapour**.

 
 
• When **oxygen **is **put into tyres **through **compressed air**, **it responds quickly**, **penetrating **the **tyre walls **and **leading to underinflation**. 
 
 
 
• **Nitrogen-filled tires **don't **generate **as **much moisture inside **when tires **expand from heat friction **then **contract when they cool**.
 
• Your tire's operating temperature is lowered by nitrogen.
 
• **Nitrogen improves ride quality.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• An **atmosphere **is **a layer of gas **or **layers **of **gases **that **envelope a planet**, and is **held **in **place by the gravity of the planetary body**.
 
• **A planet retains **an **atmosphere **when the **gravity **is **great and the temperature of the atmosphere is low**.
 
• The **atmosphere **is comprised of **layers based on temperature**.
 
• **These layers are the troposphere, stratosphere, mesosphere and thermosphere**.
 
• A further region at about 500 km above the Earth's surface is called the exosphere.
